---
title: "CFB Model Card"
format:
  dashboard:
    theme: cosmo
    css: dashboard.css
    orientation: rows
    scrolling: true
    embed-resources: true
    include-after-body: dashboard-after-body.html
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false

---

```{r}
#| context: setup
project_dir <- Sys.getenv("CFB_DASHBOARD_PROJECT_DIR", unset = "")
prediction_path <- Sys.getenv("CFB_DASHBOARD_PREDICTIONS", unset = "")
if (!nzchar(project_dir) || !nzchar(prediction_path)) {
  stop("Render through cfb_v2/render_dashboard.R so the snapshot is explicit.")
}
source(file.path(project_dir, "cfb_v2", "dashboard.R"))
raw_predictions <- utils::read.csv(
  prediction_path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE,
  na.strings = c("", "NA", "N/A", "null")
)
picks <- prepare_dashboard_predictions(raw_predictions)

season_value <- unique(stats::na.omit(picks$season))
week_value <- unique(stats::na.omit(picks$week))
season_label <- if (length(season_value)) season_value[1] else "Current"
week_label <- if (length(week_value)) week_value[1] else "Slate"
snapshot_values <- picks$snapshot_time[!is.na(picks$snapshot_time) & nzchar(picks$snapshot_time)]
snapshot_label <- if (length(snapshot_values)) snapshot_values[1] else
  format(file.info(prediction_path)$mtime, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M %Z")
provider_values <- unique(picks$market_provider_display[
  !is.na(picks$market_provider_display) & nzchar(picks$market_provider_display)
])
provider_label <- if (length(provider_values)) paste(provider_values, collapse = " + ") else "Market"
profile_values <- unique(picks$preseason_profile[
  !is.na(picks$preseason_profile) & nzchar(picks$preseason_profile)
])
profile_label <- if (length(profile_values)) profile_values[1] else "Production model"

official <- picks[picks$status_group == "official", , drop = FALSE]
reviews <- picks[picks$status_group == "review", , drop = FALSE]
forced <- picks[picks$status_group == "forced", , drop = FALSE]
provisional <- picks[picks$provisional_flag, , drop = FALSE]
injury_rows <- picks[picks$injury_flag, , drop = FALSE]

status_colors <- c(
  official = "#17745a", review = "#b86b12", forced = "#66717d", pass = "#8a929b"
)

metric_item <- function(value, label, tone = "neutral") {
  htmltools::div(
    class = paste("metric-item", paste0("metric-", tone)),
    htmltools::span(class = "metric-value", value),
    htmltools::span(class = "metric-label", label)
  )
}

pick_board <- function(data, limit = 8L, empty = "No selections") {
  data <- data[order(data$pick_edge, decreasing = TRUE, na.last = TRUE), , drop = FALSE]
  data <- utils::head(data, limit)
  if (!nrow(data)) return(htmltools::div(class = "empty-state compact-empty", empty))
  htmltools::div(
    class = "pick-list",
    lapply(seq_len(nrow(data)), function(i) {
      row <- data[i, ]
      htmltools::div(
        class = "pick-row",
        htmltools::div(
          class = "pick-copy",
          htmltools::span(class = "pick-side", row$ats_pick_line),
          htmltools::span(class = "pick-matchup", row$game_label)
        ),
        htmltools::div(
          class = "pick-numbers",
          htmltools::span(class = "pick-model", row$model_line),
          htmltools::span(
            class = "pick-edge",
            ifelse(is.finite(row$pick_edge), sprintf("%+.1f", row$pick_edge), "-")
          )
        )
      )
    })
  )
}

status_badge <- function(group, label) {
  htmltools::span(class = paste("status-badge", paste0("status-", group)), label)
}

details_cell <- function(row) {
  component_rows <- c(
    paste("Foundation", row$foundation_model_line),
    paste("Returning", row$returning_model_line),
    paste("Preseason", row$preseason_model_line)
  )
  component_rows <- component_rows[!grepl("Unavailable$", component_rows)]
  coaches <- paste(trimws(row$away_coach), "at", trimws(row$home_coach))
  coaches <- if (coaches == "at") "Not recorded" else coaches
  scenario <- if (is.na(row$injury_scenario) || !nzchar(row$injury_scenario)) {
    "most_likely"
  } else row$injury_scenario
  htmltools::tags$details(
    class = "row-details",
    htmltools::tags$summary(
      title = "Show model drivers and availability",
      htmltools::span(`aria-hidden` = "true", "+"),
      htmltools::span(class = "sr-only", "Show details")
    ),
    htmltools::div(
      class = "detail-panel",
      htmltools::div(
        htmltools::strong("Drivers"),
        htmltools::p(ifelse(nzchar(row$top_drivers), row$top_drivers, "Not recorded"))
      ),
      htmltools::div(
        htmltools::strong("Availability"),
        htmltools::p(scenario)
      ),
      htmltools::div(
        htmltools::strong("Components"),
        htmltools::p(if (length(component_rows)) paste(component_rows, collapse = " | ") else
          "Not recorded")
      ),
      htmltools::div(
        htmltools::strong("Coaches"),
        htmltools::p(coaches)
      )
    )
  )
}

edge_meter <- function(value) {
  width <- if (is.finite(value)) min(100, max(0, abs(value) / 20 * 100)) else 0
  htmltools::div(
    class = "edge-cell",
    htmltools::span(class = "edge-number", ifelse(is.finite(value), sprintf("%+.1f", value), "-")),
    htmltools::span(
      class = "edge-track",
      htmltools::span(class = "edge-fill", style = paste0("width:", sprintf("%.1f", width), "%"))
    )
  )
}

picks_table <- function(data) {
  max_edge <- max(abs(data$pick_edge), na.rm = TRUE)
  if (!is.finite(max_edge)) max_edge <- 1
  header <- htmltools::tags$thead(
    htmltools::tags$tr(
      lapply(
        c("Game", "Market", "Model", "ATS side", "Edge", "Cover", "SU pick",
          "Confidence", "Status", ""),
        htmltools::tags$th
      )
    )
  )
  body <- htmltools::tags$tbody(
    lapply(seq_len(nrow(data)), function(i) {
      row <- data[i, ]
      provisional_value <- ifelse(row$provisional_flag, "true", "false")
      injury_value <- ifelse(row$injury_flag, "true", "false")
      htmltools::tags$tr(
        `data-status` = row$status_group,
        `data-provisional` = provisional_value,
        `data-injury` = injury_value,
        `data-search` = tolower(paste(row$game_label, row$ats_pick_line, row$data_flag)),
        `data-edge` = ifelse(is.finite(row$pick_edge), sprintf("%.6f", row$pick_edge), "-999"),
        `data-order` = row$row_order,
        htmltools::tags$td(
          class = "game-cell",
          htmltools::span(class = "away-team", row$away),
          htmltools::span(class = "at-label", "at"),
          htmltools::span(class = "home-team", row$home)
        ),
        htmltools::tags$td(class = "line-cell", row$market_line),
        htmltools::tags$td(class = "line-cell model-cell", row$model_line),
        htmltools::tags$td(class = "ats-cell", row$ats_pick_line),
        htmltools::tags$td(edge_meter(row$pick_edge)),
        htmltools::tags$td(
          class = "probability-cell",
          ifelse(is.finite(row$pick_cover_probability),
                 sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * row$pick_cover_probability), "-")
        ),
        htmltools::tags$td(row$straight_up_pick),
        htmltools::tags$td(
          class = "confidence-cell",
          htmltools::span(
            class = paste("confidence-label", paste0("confidence-", tolower(row$reported_confidence))),
            row$reported_confidence
          )
        ),
        htmltools::tags$td(status_badge(row$status_group, row$status_label)),
        htmltools::tags$td(class = "details-cell", details_cell(row))
      )
    })
  )
  htmltools::div(
    class = "table-shell",
    htmltools::tags$table(id = "picks-table", class = "picks-table", header, body)
  )
}

issue_table <- function(data) {
  if (!nrow(data)) {
    return(htmltools::div(class = "empty-state", "No flagged games in this snapshot."))
  }
  htmltools::div(
    class = "issue-list",
    lapply(seq_len(nrow(data)), function(i) {
      row <- data[i, ]
      htmltools::div(
        class = "issue-row",
        htmltools::div(
          htmltools::strong(row$game_label),
          htmltools::span(class = "issue-pick", row$ats_pick_line)
        ),
        htmltools::div(
          class = "issue-detail",
          htmltools::span(row$data_flag),
          htmltools::span(row$injury_scenario)
        )
      )
    })
  )
}
```

```{r}
  )
)
```

```{r}
      id = "pick-sort",
      htmltools::tags$option(value = "original", "Slate order"),

      htmltools::tags$option(value = "matchup", "Matchup")
    ),
    htmltools::span(id = "visible-count", class = "visible-count", paste(nrow(picks), "games"))
  )
)
picks_table(picks)
```

# Model vs Market

## Row {height=560}

### Fair Margin vs Market

```{r}
plot_data <- picks[is.finite(picks$market_home_spread) & is.finite(picks$expected_margin), ]
plot_data$market_home_margin <- -plot_data$market_home_spread
plot_data$plot_status <- factor(
  plot_data$status_group, levels = c("official", "review", "forced", "pass")
)
label_rows <- utils::head(
  plot_data[order(abs(plot_data$pick_edge), decreasing = TRUE), ], 7L
)
limit <- max(abs(c(plot_data$market_home_margin, plot_data$expected_margin)), na.rm = TRUE)
limit <- max(7, ceiling(limit / 5) * 5)
ggplot2::ggplot(
  plot_data,
  ggplot2::aes(x = market_home_margin, y = expected_margin, color = plot_status)
) +
  ggplot2::geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, color = "#9aa2aa", linewidth = .7) +
  ggplot2::geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "#d4d8dc", linewidth = .5) +
  ggplot2::geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "#d4d8dc", linewidth = .5) +
  ggplot2::geom_point(size = 3.2, alpha = .9) +
  ggplot2::geom_text(
    data = label_rows,
    ggplot2::aes(label = paste(away, "@", home)),
    size = 3.1, nudge_y = 2.2, check_overlap = TRUE, show.legend = FALSE,
    color = "#1c2731"
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_color_manual(values = status_colors, drop = FALSE) +
  ggplot2::coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-limit, limit), ylim = c(-limit, limit)) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    x = "Market-implied home margin", y = "Model home margin", color = NULL
  ) +
  ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  ggplot2::theme(
    panel.grid.minor = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(12, 18, 8, 8)
  )
```

### Largest Model Edges

```{r}
edge_plot <- picks[is.finite(picks$pick_edge), ]
edge_plot <- utils::head(edge_plot[order(edge_plot$pick_edge, decreasing = TRUE), ], 14L)
edge_plot$game_axis <- factor(edge_plot$game_label, levels = rev(edge_plot$game_label))
ggplot2::ggplot(
  edge_plot,
  ggplot2::aes(x = pick_edge, y = game_axis, fill = status_group)
) +
  ggplot2::geom_col(width = .64) +
  ggplot2::geom_text(
    ggplot2::aes(label = ats_pick_line), hjust = -0.08, size = 3.2,
    color = "#1c2731"
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = status_colors, guide = "none") +
  ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(expand = ggplot2::expansion(mult = c(0, .32))) +
  ggplot2::labs(x = "Points versus market", y = NULL) +
  ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  ggplot2::theme(
    panel.grid.major.y = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(12, 90, 8, 8)
  )
```

## Row {height=520}

### Coach Alignment

```{r}
coach_rows <- picks[nzchar(picks$home_coach) | nzchar(picks$away_coach), , drop = FALSE]
if (!nrow(coach_rows)) {
  htmltools::div(class = "empty-state", "Coach assignments are not included in this snapshot.")
} else {
  htmltools::div(
    class = "coach-grid",
    lapply(seq_len(nrow(coach_rows)), function(i) {
      row <- coach_rows[i, ]
      history_flag <- !isTRUE(row$home_coach_history) || !isTRUE(row$away_coach_history)
      htmltools::div(
        class = paste("coach-row", if (history_flag) "coach-review" else ""),
        htmltools::strong(row$game_label),
        htmltools::span(paste(row$away_coach, "|", row$home_coach)),
        if (history_flag) htmltools::span(class = "coach-flag", "History review")
      )
    })
  )
}
```
